title: organizations.json
description: Organizations I taught at, consulted for, was certified by, or consumed media from, with their logos, current state and map coordinates

id.description: Stable numeric id, from the original myworld database; never reused

slug.description: URL-safe name, also the basename of the logo files

functions.description: What I did with the organization; empty for media publishers I only consumed

logo.description: The vector logo, relative to data/yaml/

logo_original.description: The bitmap the logo was traced from or replaced, relative to data/yaml/

logo_kind.description: Whether the vector logo is genuine or a trace of the bitmap
enum: traced from original bitmap (no vector logo found online)

logo_source.description: Where the genuine vector logo was fetched from (a URL, possibly annotated)

logo_license.description: The license or basis for using the logo

logo_note.description: Which version of the logo this is and any caveat

old_url.description: The organization's URL as recorded in the original database

what_happened.description: The story behind the status: who bought it, when it closed, what it is called now

website.description: The current website (of the successor, if acquired or renamed)

location.description: Current headquarters, free text: city, region, country, with annotations in parentheses

israel_office.description: The Israeli site, free text; for an Israeli company the same as its headquarters

former_website.description: The website before the acquisition or rename (a URL, possibly annotated), or 'unknown' with a note

former_location.description: Headquarters before the acquisition, move or closure, free text

geo.description: The one point a map shows for the organization, chosen by hand (scripts/organizations_pick_geo.py) from the *_geo blocks

from.description: Which place field the point was taken from

sources.description: Where the status, location and website were verified

place.description: The place the coordinates were resolved for: the free text reduced to one city, as 'City, Country'

place_geo.description: Coordinates of the free-text place field this block follows, written by scripts/organizations_geocode.py from Nominatim
